remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946....No signature. Note: Miss O'Keeffe says this was in the 1932 exhibition and painted in 1931." Abiquiú Notebooks indicated, "Back: dated 1930." Backing inscriptions dated 1930; Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1931. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks associate with 1931–32 exhibition; not among works mention in criticism or pictured in 1931–32 New York (An American Place) installation photographs. Dated 1930/1931 on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
